_source.note: observation is step 84, the first menu of the turn. The board cannot attack with anything and holds no Grass in hand; the two Basic Grass in the discard are the turn's only energy.

description: A dead turn with the engine still in the deck: active Teal Mask Ogerpon ex at 2 of the 3 Myriad Leaf Shower costs, a Meganium at 2 of 4, a second Ogerpon ex at 2 of 3, a bare Tapu Bulu, no Grass in hand and two Basic Grass in the discard. The agent played Boss's Orders and gusted a Froslass for nothing.
